title: Durham AI Safety Initiative
description: Durham AI Safety Initiative (DAISI) is a student-led organisation at Durham University dedicated to advancing AI safety research, education, and community engagement.
footerTagline: Questions, suggestions, or want to collaborate? Feel free to reach out via email or our socials!

homepage.heroTitle: Durham students and academics for reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI
homepage.heroSubtitleMain: you can contribute to the conversation and make a difference.

aboutPage.introText: We are a student-led initiative that aims to empower students and academics to reduce risk from advanced AI, by:

missionCards.title: Raising Awareness
missionCards.description: Through discussion groups and speaker events

missionCards.title: Upskilling Members
missionCards.description: In safety techniques through workshops and 1-1 support

missionCards.title: Fostering Community
missionCards.description: For high-quality discussion, support and connections to the wider field of AI safety

aboutPage.impactText: Our members have published in top AI and law conferences, participated in MATS and gone on to study AI ethics at Cambridge.
aboutPage.joinText: If you want to help organise and shape DAISI, contact durhamaisi@durham.ac.uk and we'll be in touch!

opportunities.title: Undergraduates
opportunities.description: We can advise and support you on dissertation and individual study projects.

opportunities.title: Faculty
opportunities.description: We can signpost promising research directions and funding opportunities, and support you throughout.

researchAreas.title: Interpretability
researchAreas.description: Understanding how AI systems make decisions and what they learn from data.

researchAreas.title: Governance
researchAreas.description: Developing frameworks for responsible AI development and deployment.

researchAreas.title: Evaluations
researchAreas.description: Developing methods to assess AI capabilities, alignment, and safety properties.

researchAreas.title: Oversight / Control
researchAreas.description: Ensuring meaningful human oversight and control over AI systems.

researchAreas.title: AI Agency
researchAreas.description: Understanding and managing autonomous AI behavior and decision-making.

researchAreas.title: Security
researchAreas.description: Protecting AI systems from adversarial attacks and malicious use.
